# Security reviewer

Reviews pull requests for exploitable bugs. Posts one review comment.

```text
npx @grok/agent-sdk init ./security-reviewer --template security-reviewer \
  --var repos=owner/repo
```

`--var repos` must name a repository already connected in Cursor for
your account. Separate multiple repositories with commas; they must
share one owner.

## Run

Connect GitHub in Cursor for those repos. Then sign the host in:

```text
agent-sdk login
agent-sdk dev
```

Events and API calls use your Cursor GitHub connection. Replay a PR:

```text
agent-sdk github replay https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1 --dir .
```

## Files

- `bot/lib/repos.ts`: watched repos
- `bot/instructions.md`: what counts as a finding
- `evals/review.eval.ts`: two smoke cases
